title: Make a number array
summary: A NumPy array holds values with a shared data type. np.array builds one from a Python list.
introduction: A NumPy array holds values with a shared data type. np.array builds one from a Python list. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A NumPy array holds values with a shared data type. np.array builds one from a Python list.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: Examples need Python and NumPy in a separate local environment. They are shown here with explanations; they do not run in this website's playground.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of NumPy. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.

blocks.code:
import numpy as np

scores = np.array([2, 4, 6])
print(scores.tolist())
blocks.title: Make a number array

blocks.text: The output is [2, 4, 6]. tolist turns the array back into a normal list for easy reading.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not confuse an array with one single number.
For more detail later, use this [NumPy further reading](https://numpy.org/doc/stable/user/absolute_beginners.html).
